zh: 固定较晚的位置 j，能和它配出最大差值的较早元素一定是 j 之前的最小值。
从左到右扫描，维护此前出现过的最小值，每个元素只和这个最小值配对计算差值。
答案从 0 开始（没有正差时就输出 0）；对每个元素 v，若前面已有元素，就用 v−lowest 更新答案，然后 lowest=min(lowest, v)；空数组直接输出 0。
en: Fix the later position j: the earlier element that gives the largest difference with it is the minimum before j.
Scan left to right while keeping the smallest value seen so far, and pair each element only with that minimum.

Start the answer at 0 (so the output is 0 when there is no positive difference); for each element v, if some element came before, update the answer with v - lowest, then set lowest = min(lowest, v); an empty array prints 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan from left to right, keeping the minimum so far, and pair each element only with that earlier minimum.

## Proof of correctness

With the right end j fixed, the smallest left element produces the largest difference. Going through every right end covers every possibly optimal pair; starting the answer at 0 outputs 0, as agreed, when there is no strictly positive difference.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space apart from the input.
